score_method: Minimum across all mandatory checks; no averaging. This is task-scope completion, not a measured reference similarity or game-quality score.

mandatory_checks.name: Source identity and truthful status
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: Exact plan base, historical Build 11 and newer 3fad source are separately identified. The latest note credits real cash custody, carried products, roost ownership, lit-hearth healing and removed drop-cap deletion without claiming runtime verification.

mandatory_checks.name: Complete question coverage
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: GD01–GD18 address player stakes, survivors, all seven pets, complete actor/equipment/enemy motion and each known resource/currency category across the whole-game plan.

mandatory_checks.name: Evidence and proposal boundary
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: Existing commitments, current user directives and authored recommendations are explicitly separated. Five design decisions remain openly unfrozen; reference renders are not recipe, capacity, damage or gameplay proof.

mandatory_checks.name: Readable player stakes contract
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: The standard requires warning, trigger, threatened object, consequence/exposure, counterplay, recovery, repeat/offline/save behavior and accessible cues. Current source risk is distinguished from proposed future hazards and losses.

mandatory_checks.name: Fair recovery and meaningful pressure
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: The plan preserves spend-blind challenge, realistic free completion, one primary premium currency, permanent VIP and advertised purchase value. It explicitly rejects unreviewed coercive loss, recovery softlocks and involuntary paid spending.

mandatory_checks.name: Human task parity
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: All ten physical human work families have survivor assistance requirements with achievable training/equipment prerequisites, substantial mixed carrying, later-region applicability and explicit unresolved capacity policy.

mandatory_checks.name: Delegated purchase authority and conservation
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: Player-selected plots/goals, ordinary budgets, protected reserves, authoritative shared commit, cancellation/revocation/reload and concurrent contributions are covered. No autonomous premium or real-money authority is inferred.

mandatory_checks.name: Observable intelligence and failure recovery
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: Fourteen explicit AI requirements and nine job phases cover eligibility, stable priorities, reservations, preemption, player agency, route/target/full-destination recovery, custody, perception and persistence.

mandatory_checks.name: Seven distinct useful companions
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: Seven exact species IDs and fitting role/motion examples are preserved, with standalone and team usefulness scenarios. Friendly ownership/drop eligibility is separate from wild or hostile species and no human-tool fallback is introduced.

mandatory_checks.name: Complete action/state/transition animation
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: Twelve coverage families include full actor, equipment, logistics, defense and enemy use states with authoritative contact/transaction events, interruption and recovery. Generic placeholders cannot close a task.

mandatory_checks.name: Real motion and audio evidence requirements
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: Future implementation acceptance demands complete playback, meaningful views, contact/clipping inspection and actual listening; silence/static/reused states need a justified disposition. The audit correctly reports zero game scenarios executed.

mandatory_checks.name: Exhaustive bounded resource identity coverage
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: All six registry IDs, six foundation raw IDs, three products and 33 render concepts are classified. The latest census adds money as one earned-currency transfer key with three custody locations, not three currencies. Aliases, concepts, counters and entitlements remain distinct.

mandatory_checks.name: Useful resource and currency value chain
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: Every introduced actual item must receive source, use, payoff, demand/progression, effort/cost, custody and surplus/retirement proof. Coal/slate/metal, processed-output and cash-spending gaps remain explicit. A finite meaningful use is valid; universal selling or multiple sinks is not imposed.

mandatory_checks.name: Task integration and preserved authority
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: All 70 original task definitions/dependencies and 57 directly tracked preservation baselines remain unchanged. The broader scope check preserves historical packages, canonical packets, ownership and acceptance authority. T71–T80 remain undefined. Owner/consumer mappings create no backward T31/T33 dependencies.

mandatory_checks.name: Executable planning checks and retained repair evidence
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: All six original omission/substitution defects now reject. The final five unittest methods pass; source completeness and false runtime/currency claims fail closed.49/49 exact sources and both generated crosswalk forms validate. Seven actual task-packet outputs were captured without modifying canonical packets. The original rejection is retained.

mandatory_checks.name: Frozen candidate and honest publication boundary
mandatory_checks.evidence_and_reason: All 43 substantive frozen files match their declared size/hash, with no uncovered substantive changes. This verdict approves the plan artifact only. Publication and remote readback remain the parent integration step; no current game score is granted.
